nativeMechanics.transition: Food amount after an ordinary fastLoop = clamp(0, actual Food capacity, prior amount + 0.25 × (Food production − Food consumption))
nativeMechanics.offlineTimeScaling: When webWorker.offline is true, the base 0.25 multiplier is multiplied by longRatio × offlineScale; P43 does not retain per-loop multiplier evidence.
nativeMechanics.foodPoolApplication: One zoneTally.apply call builds the Food balance. Global supply mode applies one aggregate modRes; regional mode applies one net amount per shared pool, so local balances and starvation require per-pool stock inputs.
nativeMechanics.storageOverflow: excess above the actual Food capacity is discarded after the pool update
nativeMechanics.capacityClamp: Food amount is capped at the dynamically computed current maximum; the model receives actual observed capacity rather than assuming the base value.
nativeMechanics.negativeStock: clamped to zero; native Food has no debt stock
nativeMechanics.starvation: separate from negative flow and exhaustion: a failed Food payment enters a 1-in-11 randomized check, then a death requires gross Food production below consumption / threshold (1.25 plus/minus race effects); the Food stock was already clamped at zero, and future production/consumption must be reobserved after population changes
nativeMechanics.starvationChangesFoodStock: Death itself does not replenish Food; native p5626 stock is 0 before the first recorded death at p5630. Later stock resets to 50 are not explained by starvation alone.

p728To736BoundaryCheck.interpretation: Local boundary consistency only; a single eight-period interval does not calibrate intervening inputs.

checkpointBoundaryChecks.interpretation: Local one-or-few-tick check using checkpoint rates; it does not establish the unobserved intervening trajectory.

p43AComparison.interpretation: P43 A/P42 baseline confirms p1589 Food exhaustion and starvation; p1592 stock is 50 and is not reproduced by the production/consumption-only transition.

weather.durationsAreObservationBoundaryExposure: Each captured Jobs sample is eight periods apart. Exposure holds the sampled state to the next boundary; sub-interval Weather changes are not observed.
